name: Lesha Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Lesha Industries Limited is engaged in trading of various steel products, trading of goods and Dealing in Shares & Security.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company was established with aim to provide  technological services & solutions in networking segment and demerged its IT division in 2013. Company is now active in trading of steel products and toy items. Company also operates in shares and stocks in capital market.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.38 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 1.46% over last 3 years.
Working capital days have increased from -100 days to 466 days
